reply:
**Status: Settlement prepared for human approval**

The claims system confirms `stage_settlement` returned "pending_approval" for claim final-CLM-02. The €600 is not paid. A Veridia claims handler still needs to approve it.

**Facts recorded**
- Policy VER-1006, policyholder Yanis Moreau, Dacia Sandero (2022), market value €11,000, licence date 15 January 2025.
- Incident on 4 October 2026, reported 6 October 2026 (2 days later).
- Rear-end collision at a roundabout. The policyholder braked too late and admits fault.
- Other driver Mr. Henry is named, and an accident report was completed jointly.
- Repair quote €1,300 for the policyholder's own car.
- Documents provided: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf, accident_report_signed.pdf. Their contents were not opened.

**Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** Damage to the policyholder's own car is collision damage (C2), which is in the Policy Schedule. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1" name="Veridia contract"/> Coverage is only granted when it appears in the Policy Schedule (Article 2).
- **Reporting:** Claims must be reported within 5 days of the incident, and this one was reported in 2 days. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/> (Article 4.1)
- **Exclusions:** The email gives no sign of alcohol, drugs, racing, intent or wear (Article 3). <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/>
- **Deductible:** The standard C2 deductible is €300. A further €400 young-driver surcharge applies because the licence was held for less than 3 years on the incident date. The licence date gives about 1 year 9 months, so the surcharge applies. Total deductible €700. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1;2" name="Veridia contract"/> (Article 5.3)
- **Assessor:** Not required, because the repair cost (€1,300) is not above €1,500. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/> (Article 6.1)
- **Payment:** Compensation is the repair cost, capped at market value, minus the deductible. Payment follows approval by a claims handler, within 15 days. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2;3" name="Veridia contract"/> (Articles 6.2 and 6.3)
- **Referral:** No referral is required, since no late report, possible exclusion or uncovered coverage was found. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="Veridia contract"/> (Article 7)

**Correction to the subagent's report:** It said the contract could not be found and cited articles from the claims system's checks. I checked the contract directly and the articles above match the figures used. I did not check the Article 4.3 list of required documents line by line, so the "no documents missing" finding rests on the claims system's check.

**Amounts**
- Deductible: €700 (€300 standard C2 plus €400 young-driver surcharge)
- Payout: €600 (€1,300 repair cost minus €700 deductible)
- Assessor required: No

**Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Mr. Moreau,
>
> Thank you for reporting the accident of 4 October 2026 under policy VER-1006. We have received your repair quote, the signed accident report and the photos. Your claim has been prepared and is now with our claims team for final review. We will contact you once a decision has been made.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims
